linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU (Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce 600 series / AMD Radeon HD 7000 series or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game has not been extensively tested on all Linux distributions

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (M1/M2 supported but not required)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

name: Fire at Campsite Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
